components.name: Faceplate
components.description: A 3U module panel: screws, LED, name legend, category stripe, silk text, IN and OUT jacks, foot. 8 HP shown.
components.html: DAMPERGuardBlocks risky shell commands before they run.INPRECMDOUTDENYv1.0.0VERIFIED
components.css: .ds-plate { width: 176px; height: 352px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 22px 10px 20px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--panel-hi, #eceee9), var(--panel, #dcded9) 45%, var(--panel-lo, #c9cbc5)); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25) inset, 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .35); color: var(--ink, #141517); font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-plate:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25) inset, 0 8px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / .4); } .ds-led { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--led-off, #5a2a14); } .ds-name { font: 700 1.05rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stripe { display: block; margin: 0 -10px; padding: 4px 6px; background: #b3261e; color: #fff; font: 700 .72rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-silk { font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--silk, #3b3e42); } .ds-io { margin-top: auto; font: 700 .7rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--muted, #55595e); } .ds-jacks { display: flex; gap: 4px; min-height: 40px; } .ds-jack { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 3px; width: 42px; } .ds-jack i { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--hole, #0c0d0e) 0 36%, var(--nut-hi, #e6e8e3) 37% 62%, var(--nut, #9a9d98) 63%); } .ds-jack b { font: 700 .7rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font: 500 .72rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--muted, #55595e); } .ds-seal { font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink, #141517); border: 1px solid currentColor; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Install Button
components.description: The only orange control. Copies one install line.
components.css: .ds-copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 .95rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #141517; background: #ff6a13; transition: filter .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-copy:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-copy:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .35); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Install Line
components.description: Monospace command in a well, joined to the orange Copy button.
components.css: .ds-line { display: flex; align-items: stretch; border: 1px solid #b5b8b2; border-radius: 4px; background: #f4f5f1; } .ds-line code { flex: 1; padding: 10px 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: .9em; color: #141517; } .ds-copy2 { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; cursor: pointer; font: 700 .95rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #141517; background: #ff6a13; } .ds-copy2:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }

components.name: Category Tab
components.description: Square tab with a category-coloured bottom edge; selected fills with the hue and rises 3px.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; font: 700 .95rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #141517; background: #dcded9; border: 1px solid #b5b8b2; border-bottom: 3px solid #1f5fb0; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { background: #eceee9; } .ds-tab span { margin-left: 4px; font-weight: 500; color: #55595e; } .ds-on { background: #1f5fb0; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-on span { color: inherit; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: 48px search well; border turns focus blue on focus-within.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: #f4f5f1; border: 1px solid #b5b8b2; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #1f6feb; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #141517; font: 400 1.05rem 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; }

components.name: Top Rail Nav
components.description: Anodized header rail with brand LED, condensed capital links and palette button.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #2a2c2f; border-top: 2px solid #4a4d52; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; color: #eef0ea; } .ds-brand { font: 700 1.15rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-brand em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; color: #a9aca7; } .ds-rail a { color: #c9ccc6; text-decoration: none; font: 500 1.05rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-rail a:hover, .ds-rail a[aria-current] { color: #fff; border-bottom-color: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: The gallery is a modular synth case. Black anodized rails hold rows of 3U faceplates. Each mod is a flat screen-printed panel with a name legend, a category stripe, silk text, a row of input jacks (hooks) and a row of output jacks (calls), and a foot with version and trust mark. Light theme is brushed aluminium, dark theme is black anodized. Legends are Barlow Condensed capitals; body is Barlow. Colour is rationed: neutral chrome, one category hue per panel stripe, risk as text colour, and cable orange held for the action path.
keyCharacteristics: Panel width follows jack count in HP (6, 8, 10, 12 by the longer jack row, 22px per HP).
Fixed 352px 3U panel height between 14px rails; 380px rack rows.
One LED per panel; it lights orange only on a completed copy.
Ten category hues, shown only on the stripe, tab and tab underline.
Soft panel lift only on hover or focus; no neon, glass or hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Cable Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange (#ff6a13) appears on install controls and the lit LED, and on the patch cable between them. Nowhere else: not on links, category, risk, hover or focus.

rules.name: The Amber Is Caution Rule
rules.body: Unreviewed means amber sticker, tilted -3deg, never orange and never red. Verified is a plain outlined Ink seal.

rules.name: The Stripe Carries Category Rule
rules.body: Category hue appears only on the panel stripe, the active tab, the tab underline and a hover-lit LED.

rules.name: The Silk-Screen Rule
rules.body: Every legend is Barlow Condensed in capitals with tracking. Sentences are Barlow sentence case.

rules.name: The Plain Words Rule
rules.body: A jack label is a short code; its meaning is spoken in plain words on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Lift On Response Rule
rules.body: A panel rises only on hover or focus. Shadows are soft and below the object; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do keep cable orange (#ff6a13) to install controls, the lit LED and the cable between them.
Do size a new panel by its longer jack row into 6, 8, 10 or 12 HP, using the hp-N classes.
Do keep every rack panel at 352px tall between 14px rails, with the anatomy in order: screws, LED, name, stripe, silk text, IN, OUT, foot.
Do colour the stripe, the active tab and the tab underline by the category hue, via the cat-* class custom property.
Do set legends in Barlow Condensed capitals with tracking, and sentences in Barlow.
Do mark unreviewed mods with the tilted amber sticker and say so in plain words on the mod page.
Do keep the page keyboard operable: 2px Focus Blue outline with 2px offset, 40px minimum control height, jacks focusable on the big plate only.
Do keep everything as CSS custom properties on :root with the dark overrides in the prefers-color-scheme: dark block.
Do use the SVG sprite for icons; draw hardware, do not import icon fonts.
Do avoid em-dashes in all UI text.
donts: Don't use orange for links, hover, focus, selection, category, risk or decoration.
Don't turn the gallery into a grid of same-size rounded cards with an icon, title and star count.
Don't put a focusable element inside a rack panel link; rack jacks stay plain.
Don't use inline styles or inline scripts; the CSP forbids them. Widths come from classes.
Don't show category colour as a background or text colour outside the stripe and tab.
Don't rank or badge-cloud panels; catalog order and a printed version legend are the finish.
Don't add hard offset shadows, glows, glass or gradients other than the panel brushing and the LED sheen.
Don't change the Verified seal into a colour badge; it stays an outlined Ink seal.
Don't add system display faces for legends; condensed legends come from the self-hosted Barlow Condensed.
